options.denominator: All police-reported NYC crash records with a nonmissing crash_date in that calendar year; a share of crash records, not of miles or trips
options.grouping: Calendar year extracted from crash_date, 2013 through 2025 inclusive
options.reason: A careful analyst may choose this denominator to describe fatal-crash prevalence among reported crashes, a severity measure conditional on a crash being reported.
options.answer: This crash file cannot establish whether per-mile motorist-death risk declined; crash records involving at least one motorist death were 0.0501% in 2013 and 0.0877% in 2025, with a 2013–2025 peak of 0.1180% in 2023.
